description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductDao interface for managing and querying Product entities in an e-commerce system. It includes methods for retrieving products by URL, locale, categories, tax class, store, and ID, utilizing complex JPQL queries with multiple joins for efficient data fetching.

classes.name: ProductDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of data access methods for Product entities, including complex JPQL queries with multiple fetch joins for optimized loading.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieve a product by its SEO URL within a specific merchant store and locale, fetching related entities to avoid lazy loading.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Get a list of products available in a specified locale and store, filtered by category IDs.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories
methods.description: Retrieve distinct products belonging to specified categories, with optimized fetch joins.

methods.name: getProductsListByCategories (overload)
methods.description: Retrieve a list of products by category IDs with optional filtering by language.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: List products associated with a specific tax class.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Get products available in a specific merchant store.

methods.name: listByStore (with criteria)
methods.description: Retrieve products by store with filtering, pagination, and total count, based on an extensive set of criteria.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Retrieve a product by ID with data tailored for the specified locale.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetch a product by its ID, including all associated entities needed for detailed product display.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetch a product by its SKU or code, including related entities for comprehensive information.
